analysis.reasonEn: Consecutive declines over the last 5 trading days, with daily RSI at 34.7 entering oversold territory. MACD histogram worsened from 0.7496 to -0.2523, indicating continued downtrend. Weekly ADX at 27.7 shows trend strength, but -DI is more than double +DI, favoring downside pressure. Trading near the 52-week low of $24.07 at $24.84, with potential for further decline towards the swing support at $23.49.
